note: The sub-fan quadrature combines genuinely independent engine invocations, so unlike the per-voxel quadrature inside a single run it is not obviously biased. The replica SD assumes nothing at all. 'sd_of_the_sd_relative' is 1/sqrt(2(K-1)): with K replicas the SD itself is only known to that precision, so ratios should be quoted as intervals rather than point estimates. Each replica is written to its own results/phase1a/replica_*/replica_result.json as it completes and reused on a re-run, so an interrupted multi-hour job resumes without recomputing finished replicas.
